Your watch and your phone each count steps. Health Connect keeps only one when they overlap, so a day with the watch can look short. Automatic uses the most complete count; pick an app to always use it. If the watch is missing steps, open its app (e.g. Samsung Health) so it syncs.
No health or watch apps found that work with Health Connect.

Open Samsung Health → menu (☰) → Settings → Health Connect, turn sync on and allow every data type (steps, sleep, exercise, weight, heart rate). Then open Samsung Health once so it sends its data.
Open the app, find Health Connect in its settings and allow it to share every data type.
Huawei Health does not share with Health Connect. Use the Health Sync app to pass its data along.
Watch apps usually share only from the moment you turn Health Connect on, not their whole past. For data older than 30 days, also allow history access below.

For your whole Samsung Health history: in Samsung Health open Settings → Download personal data, then pick the folder it creates (Download/Samsung Health/…). Steps, sleep, workouts and weight are added; importing again adds only what is new.
